title: TOEIC Part5 付箋の語彙・文法

questions.q: The technicians will ------- the new equipment before the grand opening.
questions.why: will のあとは動詞の原形。assemble =「組み立てる」。

questions.q: The three branch offices employ 120 people -------.
questions.why: altogether =「合計で」。

questions.q: Managers must ------- each employee's performance twice a year.
questions.why: must のあとは動詞の原形。evaluate =「評価する」。

questions.q: The audit helped the company ------- several areas where costs could be reduced.
questions.why: help のあとは動詞の原形(または to 不定詞)。identify =「~を特定する」。

questions.q: The contract ------- the contractor accountable for any delays.
questions.why: 主語 The contract は3人称単数。hold X accountable =「Xに責任があると考える(責任を負わせる)」。

questions.q: The manager spoke ------- the merger had already been approved.
questions.why: as though ~ =「まるで~かのように」(接続詞)。

questions.q: Many employees were worried about the ------- restructuring.
questions.why: 名詞 restructuring の前は形容詞。impending =「もうすぐ起こる」。

questions.q: The ------- between the two banks will be completed by March.
questions.why: the のあとは名詞。merger =「合併」(名詞)。merge は「合併する」(動詞)。

questions.q: The two firms plan to ------- their research divisions.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。merge =「合併する」。

questions.q: Please leave a 2.5-centimeter ------- on all sides of the document.
questions.why: margin =「余白」。

questions.q: The CEO has great ------- in the new product.
questions.why: great のあとは名詞。confidence =「自信」(confidential は「秘密の」)。

questions.q: Please keep this document -------; it contains customer data.
questions.why: keep O C の C に形容詞。confidential =「秘密の」。

questions.q: The museum's new exhibit is ------- a visit.
questions.why: be worth X =「Xの価値がある」。worth は前置詞のように後ろに名詞(動名詞)を取る。

questions.q: Invoices must be paid in a timely ------- to avoid late fees.
questions.why: in a timely manner(= in a timely fashion) =「時機を逃さず」。

questions.q: It would be ------- to continue the meeting without the director.
questions.why: be 動詞のあとの補語は形容詞。pointless =「無意味な」。

questions.q: The property is expected to ------- hands before the end of the year.
questions.why: change hands =「所有者が変わる」。

questions.q: The new pricing policy will be ------- as of January 1.
questions.why: be effective as of ~ =「~から有効である」。

questions.q: The board voted to ------- Mr. Davis as the new chief financial officer.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。appoint =「任命する」。

questions.q: Vitamin tablets can ------- a balanced diet.
questions.why: can のあとは動詞の原形。supplement =「~を補う」(名詞は「補足」)。

questions.q: The magazine comes with a free ------- on travel.
questions.why: a free のあとは名詞。supplement =「補足(別冊)」。

questions.q: No photographs may be taken ------- written consent from the organizers.
questions.why: without written consent from ~ =「~の書面による同意なしに」。

questions.q: The new hires showed great ------- for the project.
questions.why: great のあとは名詞。enthusiasm =「やる気、熱意」。

questions.q: Staff are asked to ------- to work by 8:30 A.M.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。report to work =「出勤する」。

questions.q: ------- the recent sales decline, the company will cut its budget.
questions.why: in light of ~ =「~を考慮して」。

questions.q: Unless otherwise -------, the meeting will start at 9:00 A.M.
questions.why: unless otherwise specified(stated) =「別段の指定がない限り」。「別の方法で~されない限り」の形。

questions.q: Customers may return any product with a ------- within 30 days.
questions.why: with a のあとは名詞。defect =「欠陥、傷」。

questions.q: The two companies signed a ------- worth $5 million.
questions.why: a のあとは名詞。deal =「取引」。

questions.q: A film ------- praised the director's latest work.
questions.why: 主語になる人を表す名詞。critic =「批評家」。

questions.q: Several residents ------- the city's parking plan at the meeting.
questions.why: 述語動詞が必要。criticize =「批判する」。

questions.q: The website removes any ------- content posted by users.
questions.why: 名詞 content を修飾する形容詞。objectionable =「不愉快な」。

questions.q: Entries for the photo ------- must be submitted by Friday.
questions.why: photo competition =「写真コンテスト」。

questions.q: As the deadline ------- near, the team worked late every night.
questions.why: 過去の文なので過去形。draw near =「徐々に近づく」。

questions.q: The firm is committed to ------- its environmental impact.
questions.why: be committed to doing =「doing に真剣に取り組む」。to のあとは動名詞。

questions.q: The annual ------- will be held in the Grand Hotel ballroom.
questions.why: banquet =「晩さん会、祝宴」。

questions.q: The technician was able to ------- the problem within minutes.
questions.why: be able to のあとは動詞の原形。diagnose =「診断する」。

questions.q: The study aims to ------- the exact cause of the machine failures.
questions.why: aim to のあとは動詞の原形。pinpoint =「正確に指摘する」。

questions.q: The new advertisement is designed to ------- to younger customers.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。appeal to ~ =「~に魅力を訴える」。

questions.q: The new software is reliable as well as -------.
questions.why: 形容詞 + as well as + 形容詞(= and)。reliable と並ぶので形容詞。

questions.q: The sharp rise in orders is ------- of growing demand.
questions.why: be indicative of X =「Xを示している」。

questions.q: The company's ------- year ends on March 31.
questions.why: fiscal year =「会計年度」。

questions.q: The bridge was built to ------- strong earthquakes.
questions.why: to のあとは動詞の原形。withstand =「持ちこたえる」。

questions.q: Because of ------- demand, the factory reduced its output.
questions.why: 名詞 demand を修飾。dwindling =「減少している」。

questions.q: Delays could ------- the success of the entire project.
questions.why: could のあとは動詞の原形。jeopardize =「危険にさらす」。

questions.q: Our fast delivery gives us an ------- over competitors.
questions.why: an のあとは名詞。edge =「優位、強み」。

questions.q: Inspectors will ------- air quality at the factory every week.
questions.why: will のあとは動詞の原形。monitor =「測定(監視)する」。

questions.q: The company reported a ------- increase in profits.
questions.why: 名詞 increase を修飾する形容詞。substantial =「たくさんの」。

questions.q: The manager will ------- the staff on the new safety rules.
questions.why: will のあとは動詞の原形。brief X on Y =「XにYの情報を伝える」。

questions.q: Please give a ------- summary of the report.
questions.why: 名詞 summary を修飾する形容詞。brief =「手短かな」。

questions.q: The ------- position will be filled by the end of the month.
questions.why: 名詞 position を修飾する形容詞。vacant =「空いている」。

questions.q: Most of the company's income ------- from overseas sales.
questions.why: 主語は income(単数)。derive from ~ =「~に由来する」。

questions.q: The ------- of the contract is two years.
questions.why: The のあとは名詞。length =「長さ(期間)」。

questions.q: After a ------- discussion, the board approved the plan.
questions.why: 名詞 discussion を修飾する形容詞。lengthy =「長い」。

questions.q: All of the ------- in the training program received certificates.
questions.why: all of the のあとは複数名詞。(all of the student is は誤り)

questions.q: The new policy affects ------- who work night shifts.
questions.why: them who ~ とは言えない。those who ~ =「~する人々」。

questions.q: Please arrive early ------- that we can start on time.
questions.why: so that ~ =「~のために」(= in order that ~)。

questions.q: ------- the office will be closed on Monday, please submit your forms by Friday.
questions.why: 後ろに文(S + V)が続くので接続詞。since ~ =「~なので」。

questions.q: The firm's profits remained ------- despite the economic slowdown.
questions.why: S remain C。C(補語)には形容詞が入る。

questions.q: The new printer works ------- quickly.
questions.why: 副詞 quickly を修飾するのは副詞。副詞は副詞を修飾できる。
questions.tag: 文法：副詞が副詞を修飾

questions.q: ------- walking through the plant, visitors must wear safety helmets.
questions.why: 「接続詞 + be 動詞」は省略できる(While (they are) walking)。during は前置詞で -ing は続けにくい。
questions.tag: 文法：接続詞＋be の省略
